I wrote the solution in `main.wj`. It compiles with the compiled toolchain and gives the right output on a short test run. I ran the examples from the task plus a blank line and an invalid date (`2023-02-29`). The run printed `60 Monday`, `2 Monday`, `0 Sunday`, `invalid` and `invalid`, with the blank line skipped. I didn't run any larger or randomised tests.

A line prints `invalid` if it doesn't
